text.official_en: ...What?

text.jp: ああ。
text.official_en: That’s right.

text.jp: ああ。
text.official_en: Yeah.

text.jp:
ああ。
今より悪くなるのは防げるかもしれない。
text.official_en: That is the hope. It may be able to prevent his eyesight from deteriorating further.

text.jp: いや、聞いたことないけど……。
text.official_en: No, don’t think so...

text.jp:
うーん。
理由はいろいろあるけど……。
text.official_en: Well...there are a lot of reasons, but...

text.jp:
お前の顔を見ると未練が募る……。
頼む。
もう俺のところにはこないでくれ……。
text.official_en:
The more I see your face, the larger this pain and regret
grow. So please...just leave me be.
text.real_en: Seeing you only makes it harder to let go... Please, don't come to see me anymore...

text.jp: これを見てくれないか。
text.official_en: Take a look at this.

text.jp: じゃ、スコットの目も！？
text.official_en: Then, maybe it’ll work on Scott’s eyes, too!?

text.jp: そういうのは苦手かと思っていたんだがな。
text.official_en: I thought you wanted to steer clear of taking on the mantle of leadership.
text.real_en: I thought you weren't very good at that sort of thing.

text.jp: その旗は……。
text.official_en: That banner...

text.jp: それでもチャンスがあるなら……。
text.official_en: If there’s even the smallest chance of saving Scott’s eyesight, we should go hunt this Dew of Reprieve down.
text.real_en: Even if there is a chance...

text.jp:
そんな大事なこと、
どうして言ってくれなかったんだ。
text.official_en: That...changes everything... Why didn’t you tell me sooner?
text.real_en: Why didn't you tell me something so important?

text.jp: ただ、その魔物は厄介な敵だと聞いている。
text.official_en: However, I’m told fighting the monster is no easy task.

text.jp: だから、余計に辛いんだ……。
text.official_en: And it pains me knowing I can’t help you.

text.jp: だったら……。
text.official_en: Then why?

text.jp:
でも、飛空艇部隊だけは
どうしても俺が率いたくてさ。
text.official_en: But this squadron is one thing I need to take the lead on.

text.jp: でもさ、きれいごとも成し遂げたら現実だろ？
text.official_en: But am I still an idealist if I can make it happen?
text.real_en: But if you make an ideal happen, doesn't that make it real?

text.jp:
なんてことだ……。
スコットの目が見えなくなるなんて……。
text.official_en: I can’t believe it...Scott losing his eyesight...

text.jp:
はは。
当たってるよ、それ。
ホントは隊長なんて柄じゃないんだ。
text.official_en: Hehe, you got that right. I really don’t think I’m cut out to be a commander.

text.jp:
まさか……。
お前が隊長に立候補するとは。
text.official_en: Well I’ll be damned... I wasn’t expecting you to throw your hat in the ring for the position of commander.
text.real_en: I never thought you'd volunteer to be commander.

text.jp: またきたのか……。
text.official_en: Back again?

text.jp: スコット……。
text.official_en: Scott.

text.jp: スコットもそうじゃないのか？
text.official_en: Don’t tell me it isn’t the same for you too, Scott.
text.real_en: Isn't it the same for you, Scott?

text.jp:
フッ。
そうだな……。
text.official_en: Heh. No, I suppose you’re right...

text.jp: レイン、寛解の雫というものを知っているか？
text.official_en: Rain, have you ever heard of Dew of Reprieve?
text.real_en: Rain, have you heard of the Dew of Remission?

text.jp: レイン、行こう……。
text.official_en: Let’s take our leave, Rain...

text.jp:
何かやれることがあったんじゃないかって
後悔ばかりが残って。
text.official_en: You’d spend every moment of your waking life crushed by the regret of thinking that maybe there was something you could’ve done—however small it might have been.
text.real_en: All you'd have left is regret, wondering whether there was something you could've done.

text.jp:
俺だって……。
あの頃の気持ちを失ったわけではない。
text.official_en: I haven’t forgotten how I felt back then. Not one bit.

text.jp:
俺の思いだって何も変わってない。
飛空艇部隊を作ろうとしたときと。
text.official_en: And my own passion—the drive I had when we first built up the squadron—hasn’t faded one iota either.

text.jp: 俺はそんな思いを誰にもさせたくないんだ。
text.official_en:
I know I wouldn’t be able to bear that.
And I don’t want anyone else to feel that way.
text.real_en: I don't want anyone else to have to feel that way.

text.jp: 俺はもうお前の期待に応えられない。
text.official_en: So I can’t work with you any longer.
text.real_en: I can't live up to your expectations anymore.

text.jp:
医者に診てもらったが、
原因不明の病のようだ……。
いずれは視力を完全に失うらしい。
text.official_en: It started several months ago. I had a doctor look at me, but he said he’s never seen anything like it. He told me I’ll eventually lose my eyesight completely.
text.real_en: I went to a doctor, but it seems to be an illness with no known cause... Apparently I'll eventually lose my sight completely.

text.jp:
数か月前から視力が衰えてきて、
ものがよく見えなくなった。
text.official_en: ...I’m going blind, Rain.
text.real_en: My eyesight's been getting worse for months. I can barely see things anymore.

text.jp: 砂漠の東にその魔物を探しに行こう。
text.official_en: To the east of the desert, then. Let’s go find that monster.

text.jp:
砂漠の東に棲む魔物から
得られるものなんだが、様々な病状の
進行を抑える効能があるとされている。
text.official_en: It can be obtained from a monster that is found to the east of the desert. It is said to contain properties that can halt the progress of various illnesses.
text.real_en: It comes from a monster that lives east of the desert. They say it can slow the progression of various illnesses.

text.jp: 自分の信念を貫くためか？
text.official_en: Is it so that you can follow through with your ideal?

text.jp:
自分の知らないところで、
誰かが傷ついたり死んだりするのは嫌だろ。
text.official_en: You wouldn’t be able to bear the thought of being powerless to save someone from getting hurt—or worse, dying, right?
text.real_en: You'd hate it if someone got hurt or died somewhere you didn't know about, wouldn't you?

text.jp:
陛下に任命された。
今日から俺が隊長として、
飛空艇部隊を率いることになった。
text.official_en: It’s official: His Majesty has named me the commander of the airship squadron.
text.real_en:
His Majesty appointed me. Starting today,
I’ll lead the airship squadron as its captain.

text.jp:
飛空艇はなくなってしまったけど、
あの頃の魂はこうしてまだ残っている。
text.official_en: The airship might have been destroyed, but the heart and soul behind it still remain in the form of this banner.
text.real_en: The airships are gone, but the spirit we had back then still lives on.

text.jp: 飛空艇部隊があればそれが叶うかもしれない、と。
text.official_en: And you think having an airship squadron will help you accomplish that?

text.jp:
１人の命も１００人の命も救う……。
お前がそれにこだわるのはなぜだ？
text.official_en: Can I ask why you’re so intent on saving everyone? On not choosing between one or a hundred lives?

text.jp:
１人の命も１００人の命も救うなんて、
きれいごとだって言う人もいる。
ムリだ、現実的じゃないって。
text.official_en: Some people say that I <text style="italic">have</> to choose between one life or one hundred lives, that I can’t save them all. They say it’s unrealistic, that I’m an idealist.
text.real_en: Some people say saving one life and a hundred is just a nice-sounding ideal. They say it's impossible, unrealistic.
